title: Nice Bitter Chinese Pickles Jiaozi
description: A traditional Chinese dish featuring bitter pickles and bouncy jiaozi, grilled to perfection with a yakimono style, this recipe is gluten free friendly and sure to impress, it is a show off chinese dish that combines the nice bitter taste of pickles with the qq texture of jiaozi.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, chopped pickles, soy sauce, sesame oil, grated ginger, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a small spoonful of the pork and pickle mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the jiaozi.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Heat a large skillet or wok with a small amount of oil over medium high heat, and when the oil is hot, add the jiaozi and cook until the bottom is golden brown.
Add a small amount of water to the skillet and cover with a lid, and steam the jiaozi for 5 minutes.
Remove the lid and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the jiaozi are cooked through and the water has evaporated.
Serve the jiaozi hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
To add a yakimono grill style to the dish, grill the jiaozi for an additional 2 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
